items.title: pa1nki113r / Project_Brutality
items.description: This is the primary repository for collaborative efforts between Doom developers on Project Brutality. This is the bleeding-edge version that is constantly being developed on, and not meant in any way shape or form to be representative of the final version of the mod.

items.title: mahjerion / Craft-to-Exile-Dissonance
items.description: A Minecraft modpack that aims to turn MC into an ARPG similar to Path of Exile and Diablo II. Focused progression and exploration is the main goal of the modpack.

items.description: SkyFactory 4 offers a brand-new experience never before seen in the series. Full automation, tech, magic, and bacon resources! This iteration offers over 30+ world types so you can play the pack like never before!
